metadata.title: HookLens demo — screenshot to report
metadata.description: How to demo HookLens in about two minutes: pick a sample, annotate hooks, generate a report.

hero.title: Two minutes to oh that's what got me
hero.description: No extension. Open Analyze, mark a sample screenshot, generate a report.

media.title: What you should see
media.description: A screenshot on the canvas, blue boxes on addictive regions, then a report page with summary cards and findings.

steps.title: Scripted demo path
steps.description: Keep this path for friends and judges. Skip anything that needs an install.

items.title: Open Analyze
items.description: Go to /analyze. Pick the Looply sample or upload your own screenshot.

items.title: Draw 2–3 boxes
items.description: Mark scroll, badge, or autoplay regions. Set hook type and a one-line note.

items.title: Generate Report
items.description: Click Generate Report. Read the summary cards and findings list together.

items.title: Ask one question
items.description: Which hook would still get you at 1am? Optionally open /apps for cleaner alternatives.

items.question: The report page says not found — why?
items.answer: Generate the report again on this device, or open a shareable /report link after it is saved.

items.question: Do I need Chrome Load unpacked?
items.answer: No. This demo is entirely web-based: screenshot in, report out.

cta.title: Run it now
cta.description: Mark two hooks on a sample and open the report.
